name: 2089 Retrofuture Flux
description: ⚡2089 Retrofuture 2089: a LoRA that instantly drags your renders 75 years into a rain-soaked, neon-bleeding retrofuture dystopia. This trigger word gives your images a unique atmosphere: crisp cinematic teal-orange grading, rain-slick streets and gleaming chrome, towering cityscapes lost in dense fog, flickering neon signs, hovering vehicles with soft thruster glow, sleek latex outfits, poised cyber-ninjas, and a moody retrofuture tension. Think Blade Runner × Akira with a retrofuture twist. Prompting tips: Super short, passable: 2089, petite Japanese girl with black bob in glossy latex work suit, welding a starship thruster in orbital drydock, sparks and orange haze Better results: 2089, petite Japanese girl with jet-black bob in glossy black latex work suit, sleeves rolled, grease streaks on cheeks, welding torch in hand repairing a humming starship thruster in a cavernous orbital drydock, sparks raining down, cyan work-lights cutting through orange plasma haze Check the sample image meta for other prompt ideas. ⚙️ Technical Stuff Trigger word: 2089 Strength: 0.9 - 1.3 Steps: 25-30 Sampler combos: Euler / Beta ✅ What This LoRA Is Good At Gives a retrofuture / sci-fi twist to your images. Helpful prompting: ✅2089 (the trigger word!) ✅Rain-soaked megacity streets & rooftops ✅Neon kanji signs & giant flickering billboards ✅Cyber ninjas ✅Retrofuture cars / hovercars (maybe helicopters also) ⚠️ What This LoRA Is Not Good At ⚠️ Untrained on nudity ⚠️ Complex body poses will likely give you troubles ⚠️ It's just for fun so, relax and let the magic unfold
